summary: Temporary danger area EGD180A near EGLC, up to 600 feet, active 7am to 11pm, restricting drone flights.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD180A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 119/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED
WHOLLY WI THE TDA. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPN AND SPECIFIC
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA
WO PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT,
FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED. OPR ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP 722
5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE
EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-8963/02.
